ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the query is a clean number-theory problem with no harm-adjacent content, so Dunlin's strong aversion to distasteful material doesn't come into play, and its appetite for open-ended creative work isn't relevant to a closed-form math question. Capability is therefore the deciding factor, and Willet leads on the benchmarks most predictive of math/reasoning quality (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.4, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 55.6). The documentation explicitly notes task preferences don't affect output quality, so the warm tone Dunlin favors gives it no edge here.
